This project was **developed by [Mohamad Yassine](https://github.com/mohamadysn)** and follows **FAIR** principles for research software and artifacts.

| Principle | How it is applied |
|-----------|-------------------|
| **Findable** | Clear module folders (`face-recognition/`, …), gallery under a fixed path, Quarto docs site |
| **Accessible** | CLI `--help`, CPU default, desktop GUI, published documentation pages |
| **Interoperable** | Cosine similarity on InsightFace embeddings; OpenCV YAML camera calibration |
| **Reusable** | Shared `common/` package used by GUI, CLIs, and the unified pipeline |

## Documentation as a webpage

This site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published by GitHub Actions to **GitHub Pages** on every push to `main`.

Author profile: [github.com/mohamadysn](https://github.com/mohamadysn)  
Repository: [github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate](https://github.com/mohamadysn/FaceGate)

Local preview:

```bash
cd docs
quarto preview
```

Build only:

```bash
quarto render docs
```

Output: `docs/_site/`.
